next.name: eCh0raix Ransomware
next.headline: eCh0raix ransomware: QNAP warns of attacks on NAS devices running older software
next.in_short: QNAP's June 2020 advisory says eCh0raix (MR1904) has been reported to target QNAP NAS devices through flaws in older QTS and Photo Station. It says fixes have been out since September 2019.

sentences.t: According to QNAP's advisory QSA-20-02, eCh0raix ransomware, tracked as MR1904, has been reported to target QNAP network-attached storage (NAS) devices.
The advisory states this only as a report. It does not independently confirm the targeting.
QNAP says the ransomware exploits certain vulnerabilities in earlier versions of QTS and Photo Station.
QNAP says it fixed these issues in releases issued since September 2019.
The advisory lists patched builds. For QTS 4.4.1 that is build 20190918 and later. For QTS 4.3.6 it is build 20190919 and later. It also lists Photo Station 6.0.3 and later for QTS 4.4.1.
QNAP published the advisory in June 2020. Its release date is given as June 8, 2020.
Owners of QNAP NAS devices should update QTS and Photo Station to the latest versions, as QNAP recommends.
